Guitar Center Exclusive Player II Telecaster with Alnico V pickups and modern playability
Alder body provides a balanced foundation for the Telecaster's single-coil voice

9.5"-radius slab rosewood fingerboard provides a smooth playing surface

products.name: Fender Player II Stratocaster Electric Guitar - 3-Color Sunburst
products.description: Fender Player II Stratocaster Electric Guitar - 3-Color Sunburst
products.productDetails:
Player II Stratocaster delivers iconic Fender tone and feel with modern refinements for today’s players
Alder body produces balanced resonance with clear highs, punchy mids and solid sustain
Modern C maple neck with satin urethane finish promotes fast, comfortable playability
9.5"-radius slab rosewood fingerboard with rolled edges offers a smooth, tactile feel with added warmth
22 medium-jumbo frets ensure confident bends and precise note articulation across the neck
Player Series Alnico V single-coil Strat pickups deliver crystalline cleans, musical mids and tight low-end response
5-way blade switch unlocks everything from glassy neck tones to cutting bridge pickup bite
2-point synchronized tremolo with bent steel saddles enables expressive vibrato with reliable intonation
Fender ClassicGear tuners help maintain tuning stability during aggressive playing and tremolo use
Synthetic bone nut enhances tuning consistency while supporting balanced string response
Vintage-inspired Stratocaster styling pairs timeless design with classic finishes from the Fender archives
